policy noncompliance is not an execution error; internal/preflight/report failures are

additional/corporate hardening remains opt-in and cannot silently enter FSTEC core
checksum sidecars are portable GNU sha256sum-compatible, basename-only, atomic, and reject symlink/ambiguous inputs

the smoke orchestrator must invoke every registered regression exactly once
runtime command/path resolution must be explicit and portable across target distributions

group membership and password aging changes require captured pre-state and explicit failed-APPLY compensation semantics
runtime snapshots must precede services that can rewrite the same kernel value; compensation order mirrors failed-transaction semantics
generated/modified executable shell must pass syntax validation before acceptance
